intents_by_check.purpose: Verify the reviewed PNG is unchanged at byte level: dimensions 1448×1086, RGB, and SHA-256 matches manifest.asset.sha256 so later mask measurements refer to the same source the agent saw during XAL overlay review.
Ensure the whole-fox mask (XAL candidate-0001, overlay-approved on contact-sheet-01) does not fragment into excessive 8-connected components after union of part masks.
intents_by_check.threshold_source: manifest.json features[fox_character].properties.max_connected_components=3 (trial policy: allow ear/torso splits, not scattered noise).

intents_by_check.purpose: Check silhouette complexity of the approved character mask stays within a coarse storybook limit (holes/components) for the combined fox region.
Confirm the fox occupies a plausible fraction of the frame after XAL whole-fox segmentation, catching collapsed or empty masks.
intents_by_check.threshold_source: manifest.json features[fox_character].properties.min_occupancy_ratio=0.18 (set below measured ~0.236 from XAL masks; not derived from hidden labels).

intents_by_check.purpose: Validate head mask topology after accepting candidate-0003 on inspection-overlays/candidate-0003.jpg and subtracting scarf overlap.
Ensure head region occupancy remains above a coarse minimum so an empty or over-clipped head fails review.
Check derived torso mask (whole fox minus head/tail/scarf) for excessive fragmentation after Codex refinement.
Verify body occupancy after derivation; catches subtraction that removed the entire torso.
Validate tail mask from candidate-0006 (contact-sheet) after clipping to character and subtracting body overlap at the attachment.
Ensure tail mask retains sufficient area for the visible bushy tail in the source art.
Check scarf mask (candidate-0007) topology; scarf may split into hanging ends but should not shatter across the scene.
Confirm scarf occupancy is non-trivial after overlay approval of the teal scarf prompt region.
Validate flower mask from candidate-0008 (left foreground blossom) remains a small number of connected components.
Ensure the pink flower mask covers at least a minimal visible blossom area.
Check mushroom mask topology from candidate-0009 after removing tail-occluded pixels identified on overlay.
Verify mushroom cap+stem occupancy meets trial minimum after occlusion cleanup.
Validate coarse background union (sky candidate-0011 + mountains candidate-0013) is not excessively fragmented.
Ensure merged upper background region covers enough pixels to represent distant sky/mountains; not a precise semantic split.
Measure intersection between scarf and tail masks where concepts overlap in the art; fail if overlap exceeds declared limit (attachment region).
